context:
Goal: every PR has one session as its owner, and combined PRs still merge.
Problem (rule): PR #3231 adds a check that fails any PR whose commits name more than one session ("25 sessions ... rebuild the lane as one new PR"). Your ruling own-767-a lets a PR combine several reviewed lanes, so a combined PR carries many sessions by design and would fail the check once it is on main. Combine-g1's lane lint on PR #3313 (head 25d4be445) already failed on it at 18:54 CST (the coordinator's read, unchecked by triage). The coordinator's undoable pick: combine-g1 rebuilds without #3231 as combine-g1b, so #3231 waits for your word. The check's own reason was an incident: PRs #1166 and #2366 went to two sessions.
Based on (read): the coordinator's report and the step's record.
Departs from: main — main has no such check; #3231 adds it. a exempts combined PRs, b reads only a PR's own lane commits, c drops the check.
Meanwhile: #3231 does not merge; the combined PR is built without it.
home: PR #3231; step one-owner-per-pr; ruling own-767-a-combined-pr; PR #3313 (combine-g1)
lastAnswer: 788: none of these, "just pick a recommended easy option for now and we review again later" (19:58 CST Nov 13). Triage picked b as the interim.

options.gain: The check keeps working for ordinary PRs, with no exemption form.
options.label: The check reads only the PR's own lane commits, so a combined PR's member commits do not count (recommended)
options.lose: The lane must define "own commits" for a combined PR; more code and a review.

options.how: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Exempt combined PRs from the check
options.lose: A second form the check accepts; a PR can claim to be combined to skip it.

options.gain: Nothing to build; combined PRs merge as ruled.
options.label: Drop the check
options.lose: The two-session PRs (#1166, #2366) can happen again with no check.

owner: coordinator (session_013NEJL1gw6EdrSyvHkTUEx6), lane one-owner-per-pr (session_013NEJL27Zw8otLsDBqaNN61); posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
reply: Triage took the recommended option b for now (the check reads only a PR's own lane commits), as an interim pick. Undo: you pick another option when you review it again, and the lane changes. Nothing merges on this until the check is rebuilt and reviewed.
short: PR 3231: one-session-per-PR check vs combined PRs
title: PR 3231 would fail any PR whose commits come from more than one session. Combined PRs do that by design. Which side gives?
why: The new check and your combined-PR ruling clash; one needs a ruling before PR 3231 merges alone.
